title: conyza spiciformis
intro: Conyza spiciformis, commonly known as Spiked Fleabane, is a plant species within the sunflower family (Asteraceae). This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions, including its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help in wound healing, reducing fever, and combating infections. The bioactive constituents of Spiked Fleabane include sesquiterpene lactones and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Conyza spiciformis include antioxidant, anti-cancer, and anti-diabetic properties, making it a valuable natural remedy for promoting overall well-being.
